name: layouts
title: Layouts: where the pages are listed (optional)
summary: A template for switchable layouts over the theme hook classes: floating rounded side bar, icon rail, floating rail, top tabs and bottom dock. Fixes the usual flat, full-height 'square' side bar.

source.ref: written for the engine, floating rules checked in Chromium against themes/dist/base.css; the older app-specific set is TurboMusic's layouts.css (see modules/appearance)
